description.value: Seahorses Café is a locally owned, family-operated restaurant perched directly over the water beside the Brentwood Bay Ferry terminal, with roughly 30 years of history on the site (current owners since 2015). The waterfront deck setting regularly draws seals, otters, a resident blue heron named Phillis, and occasional orcas. In addition to food and drink, the café also rents self-serve kayaks, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.

address.value: 799 Verdier Avenue, Brentwood Bay, BC V8M 1C5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (799 Verdier Av, Brentwood Bay, BC V8M1C5) and phone (250-544-1565). The About page confirms the café is real, locally owned, and has operated for ~30 years at this waterfront location beside the Brentwood Bay Ferry. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields are null per evidence rules; a discrepancy between OSM hours and website hours is flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM hours (We-Sa 11:00-15:30; Su 10:00-14:00) differ from the website (Wed-Thu 10:30-3:00, Fri-Sat 10:30-8:00, Sun 10:30-3:00) — website is likely more current and shows extended Friday/Saturday evening service not reflected in OSM.
OSM community field is 'Sidney' but the address and website both show 'Brentwood Bay' (Central Saanich municipality), not Sidney — directory categorisation should use Brentwood Bay.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed open via a live website with consistent contact details. Waterfront location beside a ferry terminal makes it a practical and distinctive stop for touring cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.
